summary:
Turn 88 recorded in the map that both headline consequences of the recovery defect rest on the same driven history.

State on entry. The applied-state finding is confirmed on the driven history as well: the owner admits a client proposal, runs the PreAccept round, fast-commits and the third replica installs the Commit; a replica that never saw the instance then recovers it and commits a NOOP vector, after which the replicas' state machines disagree — the recoverer applies nothing for the instance's key while the other two apply the real PUT (applied_match false with peer and third at 04 against the recoverer's (void)).

Map update (accepted base version 18, one clarified object). core_overview's connection explanation now states that the applied-state consequence is confirmed on the same driven history as the committed-vector divergence, naming both artifacts for the applied-effect claim, so a reader of the map can see that neither headline consequence rests on prepared records. The map_changes entry carries the executor, state-application and commit-install sources with a preserves explanation, and formation, context, the existing connection text and the open details are unchanged.

Frontier. Twelve claim families are settled — nine confirmed violations or consequences (C1 recovery divergence and C3 applied-state divergence both on the driven history, C2 durable-record layout, C4 NOOP-commit crash with its constructed history, C6 promoted-leader variant, C7 dead accept-rejection path, C9 recorder row in two scenarios, C10 codec truncation in three scenarios up to a receiver decode panic, C11 startup probe, C12 inert transitive-conflict skipping) and two bounded no-violation protections (C5 owner-alive re-proposal, C8 executor timeout enqueue with its recovery-start follow-up). Two candidates remain paused with scoped resume conditions, one item cannot be exercised in-package (the reader-side reaction to a displaced stream), one interpretation question stays open for the inert feature, and the attribution issue on the superseded C1 artifact remains visible as bookkeeping. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
